Q. With reference to the newly launched Paripoorna Mediclaim Ayush Bima Health Insurance Scheme for CGHS beneficiaries in 2026, which of the following statement is/are Incorrect? A. The scheme is provided by the New India Assurance Company Limited under the Department of Financial Services. B. It offers indemnity-based in-patient hospitalization coverage with Sum Insured options of ₹10 Lakh or ₹20 Lakh. C. The policy offers 100% coverage of the Sum Insured for AYUSH treatments. D. A No Claim Bonus (NCB) of 10% is provided for every claim-free year, capped at a maximum of 50% of the Sum Insured. E. No GST will be levied on the premium to ensure affordability.
